_comment: Structural roles a node type can play, declared as data.
Three node types mean something to the engine beyond their form: a Sub Flow
points at a child workflow, an Agent can hand off to sibling nodes, and a
Rule fans out into one canvas handle per branch. The source expressed that
Declaring it here means those literals exist in one file instead of being
spread across the services, and a new node type that references a child is
a JSON edit rather than a new branch in an if-chain.
Paths are dot-paths relative to the node root, the same convention the form

childReference._doc: node type -> path holding the child workflow id (a sub_flow edge)

handoffTargets._doc: node type -> path holding sibling node ids to hand off to

branches._doc: node type -> where its branches live and which key identifies one

swarms._doc: node type -> where its members and entry point live, and which node types may be members (design 7.4). The validator, canvas, store, member_list widget and mock engine read it, so none names a container type.
